verdict.rationale: BigQuery's first-party conversational analytics lets users have natural-language conversations with their data. It also supports data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms and verified queries, which is a documented semantic-grounding mechanism for NL answers. Gemini in BigQuery can find, join and query tables from natural language. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that IAM/access governance is enforced on conversational answers, evidence of how verified queries or glossary terms prevent incorrect joins, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, business users can ask questions in natural language and get governed, semantically-grounded answers rather than hallucinated joins

citations.quote: You can create data agents configured with custom metadata, instructions, glossary terms, and verified queries
Conversational analytics lets you have natural language conversations with your data.
